labs.title: Your First Workflow
labs.pitch: Run a money transfer as a Temporal Workflow. Crash the Worker in the middle of a bug, fix the bug, and watch the same transfer finish without taking the money out twice.
steps: Start a transfer with no Worker running and watch it wait.
Start the Worker, watch it finish, and read the Event History.
Hit a deposit bug, crash the Worker, fix it, and watch the transfer complete.

labs.title: Child Workflows
labs.pitch: Start a Child Workflow, chain children five deep, fan out to many at once, then write the fan in that collects their results.
steps: Start one child and find it in the Temporal UI.
Fan out, then write the fan in.

labs.title: Continue-As-New
labs.pitch: A subscription bills every cycle until its Event History grows too long and the Temporal Service ends it. Add Continue-As-New and let it run for as long as the customer stays.
steps: Watch a long-running subscription's Event History grow.
Add Continue-As-New and carry its state into the next run.
Watch the chain of runs in the Temporal UI.

labs.title: Activity Heartbeats
labs.pitch: Crash a Worker halfway through a long job and watch the retry wait, then start over from zero. Add Heartbeats and watch it resume in seconds, from where it left off.
steps: Crash a Worker during a long Activity and time the recovery.
Crash it again and watch it resume from the last Heartbeat.

labs.title: The Saga Pattern
labs.pitch: An order reserves stock and charges a card, then the courier fails. Watch nobody clean up, then write the undos that refund the card and release the stock, newest first.
steps: Unwind the undos newest first, even when the order is cancelled.
Register each undo before the step it undoes.
Make every undo safe to run twice.

labs.title: Nexus: Decouple a Monolith
labs.pitch: Payments and compliance share one Worker and one Namespace, so a bug in one takes down the other. Split them into two services connected by Nexus, each deployable on its own.
steps: Run the monolith and see what breaks together.
Build the compliance side, then the payments side.
Crash a Worker and approve a held payment by hand.
